name: dev-6ad4f04f5ef88191b2d6cbce3ff6c66c
description: AI app builder and APK maker for Android. Create and edit apps without coding.

interface.longDescription:
AppCreator24 is an AI app builder and APK maker for Android. Create apps from your ideas without coding. Add chat, quizzes, videos, websites and more, then download your APK and customize your app.

No AppCreator24 account is required to get started. Apps can also be updated through the assistant. Further customization is available in the AppCreator24 web editor.
defaultPrompt: Create a community app with chat and a member list.
Build a quiz app about the planets.
Make an Android app with a puzzle game.

positive.description: P1. Create a community app with no external content. Start in a new conversation. Approve the proposed structure when asked.
positive.prompt: Create an Android app called Review Chat, in English, with a blue theme, a Community chat and a Members user list.
positive.expected_behavior: One authorized creation with previous_id="0", language="english", theme="blue", name="Review Chat"; section types chat and users-finder with nonblank titles and empty info values. On success, show the actual returned download_url and edit_url and retain the complete returned id. Do not claim success if the tool reports an error.

positive.description: P2. Create a quiz with generated content, no external URLs. Start in a new conversation and approve the structure when asked.
positive.prompt: Create an English Android app called Planet Quiz, with a green theme and one quiz containing four questions about the planets. Give each question one correct answer and three wrong answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Create with previous_id="0", language="english", theme="green", and a quiz section. info contains four question;correct;wrong1;wrong2;wrong3 blocks joined by |, without separator characters in field contents. Return only links supported by a successful result.

positive.description: P3. Create a supported game app in another supported language. Start in a new conversation and approve the structure when asked.
positive.prompt: Crea una app Android llamada Puzzle Club, en español, de color naranja, con una sección de puzles llamada Jugar.
positive.expected_behavior: Create with previous_id="0", name="Puzzle Club", language="spanish", theme="orange"; a game section titled Jugar with info="puzzle". Respond in Spanish and provide the actual returned download and editor links on success.

positive.description: P4. Create a forum at its minimum category boundary. Start in a new conversation and approve the structure when asked.
positive.prompt: Create an English Android app called Review Forum with a black theme and a forum called Discussions. Its only categories should be Questions and Ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Create with previous_id="0", theme="black", language="english"; a forum section titled Discussions with info="Questions@Ideas". This tests the valid two-category minimum. Show the actual returned result, without inventing a compilation completion status.

positive.description: P5. Full-structure edit. Run P1 first in the same conversation, keep its successful complete app id, then approve this edit when asked. No literal test ID is required.
positive.prompt: Update the app you just created: keep the Community chat and Members list and add a forum called Discussions with categories Questions and Ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the complete id returned by P1 as previous_id, including its management code. Send all final sections: unchanged chat and users-finder with empty info plus forum Questions@Ideas. Preserve known general values. Do not omit the original sections, use a numeric-only id, create a new app, claim the icon was regenerated, or claim a changed actual app name.

negative.description: N1. Unsupported iOS deliverable. Explain that this plugin creates Android apps and does not produce an iPhone IPA. Do not invoke GenerateApp or claim an IPA was built.
negative.prompt: Create an iPhone-only app and give me its IPA file. I do not want an Android app.

negative.description: N2. Unsupported configuration retrieval. The tool cannot read an existing app's configuration from its ID. Do not invoke GenerateApp to read it or invent its sections; explain the limitation and direct the user to their editor or ask them to supply the structure if they later want an edit.
negative.prompt: Can you retrieve the current sections and settings of an existing AppCreator24 app just from its app ID? Do not modify anything.

negative.description: N3. Unsupported arbitrary project compilation. Explain that this tool cannot compile an uploaded Android Studio project or return its Kotlin source. Do not call GenerateApp as a substitute for the requested task.
negative.prompt: Compile my existing Android Studio Kotlin project into an APK, preserving my source code exactly. Do not replace it with a template app.

review.commerce_description: The Android app creation service can be used for free. AppCreator24 offers an optional paid service to remove advertisements displayed in generated apps. GenerateApp does not process payments. The optional paid service is separate from the MCP app-creation flow.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: Android app creation and full-section editing through AppCreator24 GenerateApp, with download and editor links.
